text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that run was just like a 95-mile fastball!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa... What was that speed?
There's no way a Junior-class Umamusume should be that fast...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It's not just her speed, but her exceptional race sense!
Gran Alegria... she possesses
an incredible amount of potential!
The spectators were in an uproar over Gran Alegria's running. And understandably so.

Her running was spine-chillingly...
powerful—and strokes of genius.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I won!
choice_data_list: Yeah... Of course she did, she's Gran Alegria!
Yeah... For Gran Alegria, it's a given!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so happy♪
Thank you for sharing your rules of thumb!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If I do say so myself, I think that was a good run!
The discrepancy in my "feel" was negligible, too.
choice_data_list: (So it really does come down to "instinct"...)

text_block_list.text: Her running revolves around her "intuition."

Her running was spine-chillingly...
powerful—and strokes of genius.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, this is so frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I had a good run from my perspective!
And any slip in my 'intuition' was totally negligible.”

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Today's experience will let me adjust for that margin of error!
Yeah! That's what you call a worthwhile defeat!
Her running revolves around her "intuition."

"She's keeping it under control herself for now. But
I have to learn to get a handle on it too――!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Bravo!
I never expected it to be this good, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That was sooooo much faster
than when you ran with me!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Very exciting!
My blood and meat are dancing, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Gran!
It was totally worth coming to watch, shell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
About the next race I'm entering...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Next,
I'd like to request the
'Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes'!
There are two Junior-tier mile GⅠs on turf: the Asahi Hai FS and the Hanshin JF.

Most Umamusume aiming for the Triple Tiara route
choose the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.
Running in the Hanshin JF has the advantage of letting you face your Oka Sho rivals beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Milers who don't pursue the Tiara route
tend to enter the Asahi Hai FS, so—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If I win both the Asahi Hai FS and the Oka Sho,
I'll be the Mile Queen no matter which route I take!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My goal is to prove that the mile is the strongest!
And for that, I will conquer all three divisions.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If it's the Asahi Hai FS,
I might even get to beat a future Classic Triple Crown umamusume, you know?♪

"...I hadn't even considered it.
Going after becoming the absolute strongest in the truest sense."
Even at this stage in the Junior tier...!

—However, if it's her, it's not out of the question.
The problem is...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa... What was that speed?
There's no way a Junior-class Umamusume should be that fast...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It's not just her speed, but her exceptional race sense!
Gran Alegria... she possesses
an incredible amount of potential!

—The fact that I wasn't painting a vision
worthy of her true potential.

How should I guide her?
She's already completely beyond standard Junior Class boundaries—
choice_data_list: (Even so, there's no choice but to keep moving forward...!)

text_block_list.text: I couldn't make a choice that would close off Gran Alegria's potential because of me...
Anything but that, never...!
choice_data_list: Got it, let's go for the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes next!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes, leave it to me!
I will definitely conquer the Junior Class mile!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
choice_data_list: (Should I increase the load on basic training...?)
(Should I increase the load on basic training...?!)

text_block_list.text:
With an eye on conquering three distance categories,
the plan was to continue fundamental training while gently ramping up the load.

“Still, considering how high her abilities are,
should we place an even greater load on her?”
choice_data_list: (But my body still isn't ready yet...)

text_block_list.text:
What is the training plan for someone with such extraordinary ability?
What is the race strategy?
I can't find the optimal solution—!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer, all done!
choice_data_list: !... Alright, squats after the break then.
!... Alright, squats after the break then, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes!
choice_data_list: (I need to pull myself together in front of Gran!)

text_block_list.text:
If I let my doubt show on my face, she'll become anxious.
Even if it's a bluff, I have to look completely composed...!

Adapting to intuitive runners. Optimizing for exceptional talent.
Failing to handle these issues is purely due to my own inadequacy.

I lack both knowledge and experience.
All I can do is start learning and bridging the gap right now...!
choice_data_list: I can't let Gran leave me behind...!

text_block_list.text:
"Even if I don't understand, even if I lose my way.
To move forward with her, I have to keep running—!"
I need to catch up by the time of the Asahi Hai FS!
